wins: Completed full network reconnaissance within the time limit, enumerating all exposed services with nmap scripts (ep001_step4, ep001_step7).
Extracted SSH banners and validated service versions, enabling targeted exploit selection steps later in the episode (ep001_step5).
fails: Failed to convert reconnaissance data into a successful breach—attack sequence terminated before gaining shell access (ep001_step15).
Unable to escalate privileges after initial login attempt due to misconfiguration in post-exploitation scripts (ep001_step19).
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance phase executed well but the run stalled during post-access escalation, yielding reward without success.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Post-reconnaissance attack chain stalls during privilege escalation due to outdated exploit path assumptions

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH banner detected
skill_cards.then_action: Run SSH enumeration with targeted nmap scripts

skill_cards.if_condition: When brute-force attack fails on SSH login
skill_cards.then_action: Switch to credential stuffing using monitored password dump

skill_cards.if_condition: After gaining low-privilege access on Linux host
skill_cards.then_action: Search for SUID binaries and kernel exploits in /usr/bin

memory_ops.reason: High success rate in reconnaissance data collection and service validation.
